image_description: A close-up shot of a child blowing a large, iridescent soap bubble. A smaller bubble floats in the upper left background. The large bubble dominates the foreground, showing strong rainbow interference patterns and reflecting the child's face and blue hat. A pink bubble wand is held by a hand on the left side.
